concerns.text: Task T015 (full reproducibility run) is placed at the start of the execution order and again at the end. It depends on artifacts produced by virtually all prior tasks (models, results, reports). Running it before those producers violates the producer‑before‑consumer rule.

Task T013 (seed‑check) is scheduled after many stochastic tasks (e.g., train/test split, model training). Since it validates that all scripts use the fixed seed 42, it must run **before** any stochastic operation to be effective. Its current position creates a hidden ordering dependency.
